    "Robust e-commerce functionality and dedicated features.",

    "Reliable platform for client online stores."

  "cons": [
    "Limitations of Liquid templating for complex custom logic.",
    "Costs of premium apps and transaction fees can add up.",
    "Less control over core platform architecture compared to self-hosted solutions."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This backend developer found Shopify to be a significant upgrade from Wix, appreciating its dedicated e-commerce features and robust API for custom development. They likely valued its reliability and scalability for building client stores. While generally positive, some frustrations may have arisen from the inherent limitations of a SaaS platform's templating language and the accumulating costs of necessary apps."
